brief: GS's TMT desk notes NDX closed +50bps on 6 Oct while the Russell 2000 fell about 50bps, with breadth again mixed. Sentiment feels mixed at best as investors debate whether to keep chasing Tech/AI, the only US equity story working over the past month, given the current backdrop of rates, oil, weak breadth and elections, or wait for a pullback as leaders like Semis, Mag 7 and Cyber near overbought levels. In Cyber Security, CRWD now trades near 40x forward EV/Sales, approaching its 2020/21 peak multiple, but 10-year yields are near 5.5% now versus about 1% then, leaving GS fielding questions on whether fundamentals can grow into that multiple even as the thematic trend argues for staying with it. Heading into 3Q internet earnings, investors increasingly ask whether chasing follow-through beyond the print is worth it, tied to Agentic Commerce and oil/rates debates, with OTA weakness (ABNB) but few bottom-fishing calls across BKNG, EXPE, UBER, NFLX, PINS and APP. In Semis, Optics/Networking/Compute names (AMD, ANET, LITE, MRVL) trade near 40x forward P/E versus NVDA, AVGO and TSM at a discount, a gap GS ties to margin and scale differences that have stayed fluid for over 3.5 years.
